decisions.reason: Because it is a low-uncertainty extension of the core offer and the large firm has enough slack to continue it, but its limited visibility and overlap with other express offers make it a plausible candidate for pruning if results fall short of aspiration.

Because very fast delivery fits the firm's service promise, management is likely to keep testing it, yet the operational strain and only modest public prominence mean it is the express variant most at risk if performance misses aspirations.

Because this product is highly aligned with the firm's safety-focused core business, was prominently launched, and likely supports aspirations for differentiated compliant solutions, management would be very likely to retain it.

Because an express program for doors and gates fits the established business and service network and was given dedicated website space, it is likely meeting or near aspiration and therefore likely to be kept.

Because the digital platform supports the firm's strategic move toward deeper advisory and service support and a large firm can absorb early ramp-up costs, management is likely to keep it despite some adoption uncertainty.

Because fire and smoke protection is central to the firm's compliance-oriented offering and uses existing technical capabilities, management would likely keep it unless early sales clearly disappoint relative to aspiration.
